en: Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor a fetter … (Abbreviated.
Under the root condition there are twenty-nine; under the object condition, twenty-four … pe … under the result condition, nine … pe … under the non-disappearance condition, twenty-nine.
Dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor a tie … pe … dependent on a state that is neither wholesome nor a flood … pe … dependent on a state that is neither wholesome … [and so forth].

Dependent on a state that is neither-yoked, ... [as before] ... dependent on a state that is neither-wholesome nor a hindrance, ... [as before] ... dependent on a state that is neither-wholesome nor associated-with-delight, ...
[abbreviated]. In the case of root-condition there are twenty-nine;
in the case of object-condition there are twenty-four, ... [as before] ... in the case of resultant there are nine, ... [as before] ... in the case of non-disappearance there are twenty-nine.
